title: The Government’s Intention to Preserve the Site of 38 Oxley Road
what_it_is: The Government’s Intention to Preserve the Site of 38 Oxley Road

sections.label: Government intends acquiring 38 Oxley Road
sections.summary: The Government intends to acquire 38 Oxley Road under the Land Acquisition Act if a Preservation Order is made.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr David Neo)
sentences.text: As outlined in the joint National Heritage Board (NHB) and Singapore Land Authority (SLA) media release on 3 October 2025, the Government intends to acquire the site of 38 Oxley Road under the Land Acquisition Act if a Preservation Order is made.

sections.label: Singapore National Monuments count
sections.summary: Singapore has 76 National Monuments as a young nation.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr David Neo)
sentences.text: As a young nation, we have 76 National Monuments in Singapore.

sections.label: Demolition application and NHB assessment
sections.summary: After Dr Lee Wei Ling died in October 2024, URA received a demolition application and NHB launched a formal assessment of the site.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr David Neo)
sentences.text: The Government had made it very clear that we would not do anything to affect her right to live in the house.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr David Neo)
sentences.text: But after Dr Lee Wei Ling passed away in October 2024, the URA received a demolition application for the building at 38 Oxley Road.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr David Neo)
sentences.text: Hence, NHB launched a formal assessment of the site in line with established processes under the PMA to determine if it was worthy of preservation.

sections.label: PSMAB assesses 38 Oxley Road significance
sections.summary: The PSMAB assessed 38 Oxley Road to have strong national significance, worthy of preservation as a National Monument.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr David Neo)
sentences.text: The PSMAB have assessed 38 Oxley Road to have strong national significance, worthy of preservation as a National Monument.

sections.label: Acting Minister agrees with recommendations
sections.summary: As Acting Minister for Culture, Community and Youth, he received the recommendations and agrees with them.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr David Neo)
sentences.text: In my capacity as Acting Minister for Culture, Community and Youth, I have received the recommendations, and I agree with them.

sections.label: Preserving and acquiring site prevents redevelopment
sections.summary: Preserving and acquiring the site means it cannot be redeveloped for residential, commercial or other private uses.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr David Neo)
sentences.text: Preserving and acquiring the site means that it cannot be redeveloped for residential, commercial or other private uses.

sections.label: Site as public heritage park
sections.summary: If preserved and acquired, the Government intends the site to become a public space such as a heritage park.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr David Neo)
sentences.text: If the site is to be eventually preserved and acquired, the Government's thinking is for it to be developed into a public space, such as a heritage park, so that Singaporeans can have access to it and it can be a park of our shared memories.

sections.label: Plans within this term
sections.summary: If preserved and acquired, the Government intends to conclude plans on the site's use and configuration within this term.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr David Neo)
sentences.text: If 38 Oxley Road is indeed preserved and acquired, the Government fully intends to conclude its plans on the exact use and configuration of the site, including the treatment of the buildings and the structures on the site well within this term of Government.

sections.label: Preservation Order then acquisition
sections.summary: If objections are considered and preservation proceeds, a Preservation Order will be made and acquisition commenced.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr David Neo)
sentences.text: If, having heard and considered the objections, the decision is to proceed with the preservation, a Preservation Order will be made.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr David Neo)
sentences.text: The Government will then commence the process for the acquisition of the site as part of the plans to eventually make it accessible to the general public.

sections.label: Removing private spaces traces
sections.summary: If the site is preserved, the Government commits to remove all traces of Mr Lee's and his family's private spaces.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr David Neo)
sentences.text: In fact, if we preserve it, we commit to remove all traces of Mr Lee's and his family's private spaces.

sections.label: Stakeholder engagement for site
sections.summary: If preserved and acquired, agencies will identify stakeholder groups and conduct engagements to shape the site's future.

sentences.speaker: Mr David Neo
sentences.text: If the site is preserved and acquired, the agencies will look to identify possible stakeholder groups and conduct engagements to help shape the future of the site and to ensure that the potential of the site for public education is maximised.

sections.label: Assessing site condition
sections.summary: If acquired and access obtained, agencies will assess the condition of the site, buildings and structures.

sentences.speaker: Mr David Neo
sentences.text: If the site is acquired and access to the site is obtained, our agencies will proceed to assess the condition of the site, and that of the buildings and the structures.

sections.label: No Preservation Order Yet
sections.summary: Agencies take prudent steps, but without a Preservation Order firm timelines on the site would be premature.

sentences.speaker: Mr David Neo
sentences.text: These are all prudent and necessary steps that any agencies take in evaluating any potential developments.

sentences.speaker: Mr David Neo
sentences.text: However, at this point in time, because a Preservation Order has not been made, it will be premature for us to provide any firm timelines on the site.

sections.label: Preserved Site As Heritage Park
sections.summary: If the site is preserved and acquired, it will become a public space, possibly a heritage park for education.

sentences.speaker: Mr David Neo
sentences.text: If the site is preserved and it is acquired, we will convert it into a public space, possibly a heritage park through which we will educate the current and future generations on this very significant part of Singapore's journey.

sections.label: Notice Of Intention Process
sections.summary: No decision has been made; the Notice of Intention under the PMA allows objections before a decision on gazetting.

sentences.speaker: Mr David Neo
sentences.text: On the first one about Mr Lee's wish, I would like to reiterate to this House that at this moment in time and at this stage, no decision has been made yet.

sentences.speaker: Mr David Neo
sentences.text: The issuance of a Notice of Intention is a process under the PMA, allowing for the owner or occupier of a proposed National Monument to submit any objections of the intention to gazette the proposed National Monument, before a decision has been made.

sections.label: Removing Private Living Spaces
sections.summary: In removing all traces of Mr Lee's and his family's private living spaces, we respect his wish for privacy.

sentences.speaker: Mr David Neo
sentences.text: In committing to removing all traces of Mr Lee's and his family's private living spaces, we respect Mr Lee's wish for privacy.

sections.label: Acquiring Site For Historical Significance
sections.summary: Government assessed that if preserved, public interest is best served by acquiring the site to safeguard its historical significance.

sentences.speaker: Mr Foo Cexiang (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: Second clarification, can I seek confirmation from the Minister, point blank, that the paramount reason for the Preservation Order is not because the site is the family home of Mr Lee Kuan Yew, but because it is a historical site where political meetings, activities, decisions which led to the establishment of Independent Singapore, that that was where it took place?

sentences.speaker: Mr David Neo
sentences.text: First, on why is there a need for Government to acquire, the Government has assessed that if the site is preserved, the public interest is best served by acquiring the site to safeguard it and to maintain it in keeping with its historical significance and national importance.

sections.label: Notice Of Intention On 3 November
sections.summary: Only a Notice of Intention to preserve the site was issued on 3 November, and no decision has been made yet.

sentences.speaker: Mr David Neo
sentences.text: As stated in my Ministerial Statement, we have currently only issued a Notice of Intention to preserve the site, which was done on 3 November.

sentences.speaker: Mr David Neo
sentences.text: This is the established process for all National Monuments and we are adhering to this same process for the site as well.

sentences.speaker: Mr David Neo
sentences.text: Therefore, for this reason, as I also mentioned to Member Mr Alex Yam, no decision has been made yet on whether or not the site will be preserved.

sections.label: Site access and cost assessment
sections.summary: The Government needs access to assess the site's condition and weigh costs and benefits before deciding and committing to a timeline.

sentences.speaker: Mr David Neo
sentences.text: We need to gain access to look at the condition of the site, the buildings, the structures of the site, and weigh the costs and benefits, before we can make a decision and before we can commit to a key timeline.

sentences.speaker: Mr David Neo
sentences.text: But the point I made remains that this Government intends to make a deliberate decision on the exact configuration well within this term of Government.

sections.label: PSMAB independent expert board
sections.summary: PSMAB is an independent board of experts from relevant fields who assess the merits of each case independently.

sentences.speaker: Mr David Neo
sentences.text: On the first point, I just want to make a point that PSMAB is an independent board made up of experts from different fields that are relevant to this subject matter, and their job is to assess the merits of each case independently.

sections.label: National monument assessment process
sections.summary: The established process for assessing national monuments includes qualitative and quantitative assessments of national significance, historical merit and architectural design merit.

sentences.speaker: Mr David Neo
sentences.text: The established process for which all national monuments are assessed includes both qualitative and quantitative assessments of the identified sites' national significance, historical merit and architectural design merit.

sections.label: No decision on preservation yet
sections.summary: The Government has not decided whether to preserve or acquire the site, and all options remain open on the final configuration.

sentences.speaker: Mr David Neo
sentences.text: For the Member's suggestion about the different configurations that can take place as part of subsequent developments, I want to reiterate, first of all, that it is still premature for us to state, because at this moment in time, the Government has not made a decision as to whether it will be preserved, and if preserved, it will be acquired.

sentences.speaker: Mr David Neo
sentences.text: They need to go in, they need to assess all the different buildings and structures of the site, weigh the cost and benefits before coming to a recommendation.

sentences.speaker: Mr David Neo
sentences.text: And the third point, as I stated in my Ministerial Statement, at this moment in time, all options are open when it comes to the final configuration.

sections.label: Gazette intention and future plans
sections.summary: With the Government announcing its intention to gazette 38 Oxley Road as a National Monument, focus should be on future plans.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gho Sze Kee (Mountbatten)
sentences.text: I understand that the Government has to act because a demolition application has been submitted.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gho Sze Kee (Mountbatten)
sentences.text: Now that we are at this point where the Government has announced the intention to gazette 38 Oxley Road as a National Monument, our focus should be on future plans.

sections.label: Decision after objections and drawer plans
sections.summary: Any preservation decision will be made after considering objections during the notice period, and the 2018 Ministerial Committee prepared drawer plans and options.

sentences.speaker: Mr David Neo
sentences.text: Any decision on the preservation will only be made after considering any objections received during this notice period.

sentences.speaker: Mr David Neo
sentences.text: On the Member's second question on whether it is necessary, the 2018 Ministerial Committee has always said that it has prepared the drawer plans and the options for a future government to decide on what to do with the site when the time comes.

sections.label: Timing of final decision
sections.summary: The government intends to make a final decision well within this term of government for the benefit of Singapore and Singaporeans.

sentences.speaker: Mr David Neo
sentences.text: Because, as I said in my Statement, the time has come, this is the relevant time.

sentences.speaker: Mr David Neo
sentences.text: And we do fully intend to make a decision well within this term of government and make a final decision that will be for the benefit of Singapore and Singaporeans now and for the future.

sections.label: Acquisition process and compensation
sections.summary: The acquisition will follow established processes, with compensation under the Land Acquisition Act, claims submitted to SLA, and a private valuer appointed.

sentences.speaker: Mr David Neo
sentences.text: As I stated in my Ministerial Statement, the acquisition will be done in accordance with established processes and any compensation will be made in accordance with the Land Acquisition Act.

sentences.speaker: Mr David Neo
sentences.text: And as part of this, the owner, occupiers, any other persons interested, will be given the opportunity to submit their claims to SLA to determine the compensation amount.

sentences.speaker: Mr David Neo
sentences.text: And then a professional private valuer would also be appointed to assist SLA in determining the market value of the land, and taking into considerations any claims submitted.

sections.label: Private and personal spaces treatment
sections.summary: Less private spaces like the basement dining room were documented before Mr Lee's passing, while personal spaces like bedrooms would be reconfigured or removed.

sentences.speaker: Mr David Neo
sentences.text: To his question about the private dining room, there are spaces within the buildings that have been widely documented in different forms of media in the past, and all these were done prior to Mr Lee's passing, the basement dining room being one of them, that we would consider less private.

sentences.speaker: Mr David Neo
sentences.text: But there would be other spaces, such as bedrooms, which do not have any association with the historically significant events that took place at the site, and to respect Mr Lee's wishes, such personal spaces would then be reconfigured or removed, and it will range from removing furnishings, fixtures or any objects still left, to potentially also tearing down such spaces, while taking into consideration issues like structural integrity and the safety of the buildings.

sections.label: Examples of preserved buildings
sections.summary: Examples include the former Supreme Court, now the National Gallery of Singapore, and the Sun Yat Sen Nanyang Memorial Hall.

sentences.speaker: Mr David Neo
sentences.text: Some examples include the former Supreme Court, currently the National Gallery of Singapore, and the Sun Yat Sen Nanyang Memorial Hall.

sections.label: Founders' Memorial location
sections.summary: The Founders' Memorial is recreated on reclaimed land.

sentences.speaker: Mr David Neo
sentences.text: The Founders' Memorial is recreated on reclaimed land.

sections.label: Uniqueness of the site
sections.summary: The site is unique because it is not the same space where the struggles took place, lacking the same sense of authenticity.

sentences.speaker: Mr David Neo
sentences.text: It is not the same space where the struggles took place.

sentences.speaker: Mr David Neo
sentences.text: There will not be that same sense of authenticity and which is why, like I explained early in my clarification, this site is unique, and it behooves us to preserve it.

sections.label: Land Acquisitions Act due process
sections.summary: A Minister, not the National Development Minister, commits that due process, independent valuation and any required disclosure under the Land Acquisitions Act will be followed.

sentences.speaker: Mr David Neo
sentences.text: Unfortunately, I am not the Minister for National Development.

sentences.speaker: Mr David Neo
sentences.text: I am not totally au fait with what is required under the Land Acquisitions Act, but my commitment to the Member is that due process will be given and it will follow the requirements under the Land Acquisitions Act, and an independent valuation will be done.

sentences.speaker: Mr David Neo
sentences.text: If the Act requires a disclosure, the disclosure will be done as well.
